purpose: Teach: 前作/反復/ハードル/ベタ/アンコール/アウトドア/大晦日/ぶどう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、好きな映画の、絶対、前作、絶対、見たの?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, seriously — have you actually watched the first film in that series you love?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested lean-in. Soft emphasis on 'seriously' — testing whether Aoi will admit it. Pace unhurried, giving space for an honest answer.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お料理、絶対、反復、絶対、練習、絶対、してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I actually do practice cooking techniques over and over, you know.
lines.style: Defensive but not unkind. Slight catch on the opening — she's about to explain herself before Mei even asks. Quiet conviction underneath. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、ハードル、絶対、高いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The bar you've set for this new menu is pretty high, isn't it?
lines.style: Gentle observation, not quite a question. Soft landing on each phrase. She's noticing Aoi's pressure without naming the worry directly. Trailing-off suggests she's hoping Aoi hears the care underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ベタ、絶対、なロマンス映画、絶対、好きよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I do have a real soft spot for those corny romantic movies, actually.
lines.style: Lighter, almost bashful admission. Quick smile in the voice — letting Mei see something tender and unguarded. A little breathless, like she wasn't planning to say it out loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、コンサートの、絶対、アンコール、絶対、すごかったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That concert encore was absolutely incredible, wasn't it?
lines.style: Sudden brightness. She's lifted by the memory. Emphatic on 'absolutely' — genuine enthusiasm, no performance. Leaning forward with the words, inviting Aoi to relive it with her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、アウトドア、絶対、お休み、絶対、行きたいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really do want to get away somewhere outdoorsy, you know?
lines.style: Hopeful, almost asking permission. Slightly urgent undertone — she wants this and wants Aoi to want it too. Voice brightens on 'outdoorsy' like it's a small dream she's carrying.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、大晦日、絶対、お店、絶対、忙しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: New Year's Eve is going to be so hectic at the shop, isn't it?
lines.style: Gentle recognition of the coming storm. Slower pace, settling in. She's not worried for herself — she's thinking about Aoi. Soft, steady, the voice of someone who's about to offer to help.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新メニューの、絶対、ぶどう、絶対、タルト、絶対、人気よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new grape tart's been flying off the shelves, hasn't it?
lines.style: Genuine pride in her voice. Warm smile underneath. Emphatic on 'flying off' — she's delighted for Aoi's success. Bright, affectionate closer. The tone of someone watching someone they love do well.
